How to play

Swap neighboring candies by clicking or dragging. Match 3 or more in a row or column. You have 25 moves and no timer; invalid swaps are free.

  • Striped candies clear a row or column. Wrapped candies clear a 3 × 3 area.
  • Swap a rainbow with a candy to clear its color. Two rainbows clear the whole board.
  • Each candy gives 10 points. Cascades multiply points by ×2, then ×3 without using another move. The multiplier resets on your next swap.
  • Earn stars at 500, 1,200, and 2,000 points. Each new star gives 10 coins, once.
  • Reach 2,000 points to win. Cascades from your last move finish before the results appear.
  • No possible matches? The board reshuffles for free and keeps your special candies.

Keyboard: arrows to move, Enter or Space to select. P or Escape to pause. Switching tabs pauses automatically.
